Evan: Noticed p99 spike on Mistral 8x7B sliding-window around 01:07 UTC — median fine but tails shot up.
Mia: Any pattern in seq lengths or ops? :thinking_face: 
Evan: Yes — kernel_selector chose scalar_gemm for lengths hitting a tiling edge. snippet:
```
kernel_selector: seq=257 tile=256 -> fallback=scalar_gemm reason=mask_edge
```
Raj: That masks wrap sentinel we've been using for sliding windows. One-row sentinel breaks assumptions about contiguous KV tiles.
Simone: Could the selector be conservative about near-boundary lengths instead of full fallback?
Evan: I added a tiny heuristic to prefer fast_block_gemm when (seq - tile) < 4 and cost estimate close. Patch: mrsl/runtime/selector/edge_bias.patch (+6 LOC).
Mia: Benchmarks?
Evan: On A100 (8x7B quant): before p99=420ms, after p99=150-170ms. p50 unchanged. Throughput minor regression for huge batches (~2-4%). Data:
```
before p50=20 p95=85 p99=420
after  p50=21 p95=82 p99=160
```
perf-bot: summary host_cpu=13% gpu=86% kernel_breakdown={fast_block_gemm:61, scalar_gemm:29, other:10}
Mia: Separate concern: RoPE scaling change earlier caused KV pointer arithmetic to show off-by-one when layout changed — shows up only when kernel switches layout.
Raj: We had kv_ptr_wrap_on_config_change hotfix for config reloads but not for on-the-fly kernel layout changes.
Simone: Proposal: when selector changes layout, emit an event to rebase KV pointers for inflight sessions. Also add cheap runtime check: (kv_ptr % stride == 0) else rebase.
Evan: I'll implement both and add a rebase counter metric. Also unit tests for mask sentinel variants and selector monotonicity around tile-3..tile+3.
Mia: For canary, reduce batching delay for sliding-window flows from 8ms -> 5ms to lower batch heterogeneity.
Raj: Canary plan: Dedicated pool, 50 sessions, synthetic sliding-window traffic (windows [128,256,512,1024] and RoPE scales [0.5,1.0,1.5]). Fail if rebases/sec > 0.1 or p99 regresses > 2x.
Evan: PR pushed: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/8421
Mia: Running perf harness overnight, will post CSV tomorrow. :thumbsup: 
infra-bot: canary deployed pool=dedicated-gpu-3 version=evan/selector-kv-rebase-2026-03-18
